text:
Nina L: Urgent: one of our reviewers (contractor) gave notice and is leaving Friday. They're assigned to 18 handbacks that are due before the calibration on Monday. Need a quick plan to reassign so calibrations aren't blocked.

Amanda R: Do we have a list of which reviews they're primary reviewer for? If it's <20 we can reassign to backup reviewers; if more we may need to split work across managers.

Nina L: Exported assignments to /internal/people-ops/handbacks/exports/1798550000-leaving-reviewer.csv

People Ops Bot: Incident created: INC-2890 "Reviewer departure impacting handbacks". Auto-tagged priority=high.

Samir H: Quick approach: 1) identify backups from assignments.csv (column backup_reviewer_email) 2) if backup is empty, assign to manager as fallback 3) send manager approval ping. I can script the reassign in 20m if we get approvals.

Jess M: I'll draft the manager note: short ask to approve reassignment to backup or manager. Template: "We need approval to reassign <employee>'s pending handbacks to <backup>. Reply 'approve' to confirm by EOD."

Amanda R: Also add a protective note for calibration: mark reassigned reviews with tag reassigned_due_to_departure so the calibration lead knows context.

Samir H: Running a quick join: 18 rows -> 11 have backup_reviewer, 7 empty. Pushing a partial reassign for the 11. For the 7 empty I'll set manager fallback and include a manual check list.

People Ops Bot: Reassign job queued: JOB-7781. Affected exports: /internal/people-ops/incidents/INC-2890/affected_list.csv

Nina L: I'm DM'ing managers for the 7 fallback ones. Please don't touch forms for now; just update reviewer_id in the assignment table.

Jess M: Managers replied for 5/7 approve->assign to manager, 2 asked to delegate to a peer. I've collected delegate emails and adding to CSV.

Samir H: JOB-7781 executed at 1798550335. All 18 handbacks reassigned. Added tag reassigned_due_to_departure to those rows. Backups got 11, managers got 5, delegated peers got 2.

People Ops Bot: INC-2890 update: reassign complete. Audit log: /internal/people-ops/incidents/INC-2890/audit.log. Notifying calibration lead and running a quick sanity export.

Amanda R: Thanks everyone. Jess, please send a short comms to new reviewers: deadline unchanged, let them know original reviewer left and whom they should contact for context. Nina, please confirm calibration lead got the updated export.

Jess M: Comms sent and delivery receipts show all new reviewers got the note.

Nina L: Calibration lead confirmed and included the reassigned tag in the panel materials. Closing INC-2890 after final checks.

People Ops Bot: INC-2890 resolved at 1798550450.
